d: We are seeking a highly experienced and strategic Chief Risk Officer / Chief Financial Officer to lead the organisation's financial management, enterprise risk management, and corporate governance functions. The successful candidate will oversee financial strategy, business performance, risk governance, capital management, and internal controls while providing strategic advice to the Board and executive leadership team. This role requires strong financial expertise, risk management capabilities, and executive leadership to support sustainable business growth, financial stability, and long-term organisational success.
Develop and execute financial and enterprise risk management strategies aligned with corporate objectives.
Oversee financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, cash flow management, and financial performance.
Lead financial reporting, accounting operations, financial analysis, and management reporting.
Establish and maintain enterprise risk management frameworks, policies, procedures, and internal controls.
Identify, assess, monitor, and mitigate financial, operational, strategic, regulatory, and reputational risks.
Monitor profitability, liquidity, capital allocation, investment activities, and financial sustainability.
Ensure effective financial governance, corporate risk oversight, and regulatory compliance.
Lead financial audits, risk assessments, internal reviews, and control improvement initiatives.
Advise the Board and senior management on financial strategy, business risks, investments, and strategic decisions.
Oversee treasury management, financing arrangements, banking relationships, and capital structure.
Develop risk mitigation strategies, crisis management frameworks, and business continuity plans.
Monitor market conditions, economic developments, and emerging financial and business risks.
Lead, mentor, and develop finance, accounting, treasury, and risk management teams.
Coordinate with external auditors, financial institutions, consultants, and key stakeholders.
Drive operational efficiency, cost optimisation, financial discipline, and sustainable business growth.
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, Risk Management, or a related discipline.
Professional qualifications such as ACCA, CPA, ACA, CFA, FRM, or equivalent are preferred.
MBA or Master's degree in Finance, Risk Management, or Business Administration is an advantage.
Minimum 10–15 years of relevant experience in finance, accounting, corporate risk management, or financial leadership.
Proven experience in a senior financial management, CFO, CRO, or executive leadership position.
Strong knowledge of financial reporting, corporate finance, budgeting, forecasting, treasury, and investment management.
Good understanding of enterprise risk management, internal controls, corporate governance, and regulatory compliance.
Experience in financial strategy, capital management, risk assessment, and business performance optimisation.
Strong leadership, strategic planning, analytical, and decision-making capabilities.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including Board-level reporting.
High standards of integrity, professionalism, accountability, and business ethics.
Excellent command of written and spoken English.
